description:
The People's Commons 1.2.1
The means of life are a common inheritance.

The People's Commons is a dirty commie faction on the inhabited Sector's frontier. It's flavour is strongly inspired by China, but in an intentionally optimistic reading of its later stage of development; common ownership, extensive automation. Its navy intends to share that achievement with the Sector.

Shared missile guidance systems and superior missile engineering define a fleet built around precision missiles. The goal with this faction was to build an engaging missile-oriented roster that eschews the missile saturation meta with limited ammo, limited salvo sizes and normal missile hit points. Rewarding and punishing.

In order to make this possible the faction has unique missiles and ship systems offering speed, handling and tracking buffs on a cooldown as well as a hullmod further improving missile tracking and handling that benefits from allies with the same hullmod.

Download
The People's Commons 1.2.1

Requires LazyLib 3.0.0 and MagicLib 1.5.6.
Optional: Nexerelin, Combat Chatter.

Included

Twelve new warships, just enough to form distinct doctrines of a fast strike flotilla, a line fleet, and independent commands
Three new wings in four-fighter, three-striker and two-bomber sections
Seven new built-in precision missiles with unique graphical effects
Daybreak, a three-world home system just beyond the Core
Twenty portraits, four named officials, immersive local descriptions and faction-specific dialogue
Three missions to try out each doctrine easily
Nexerelin compatible, including blueprint availability in goodies bin
Combat Chatter compatible, automatically applied to People's Commons ships/officers with new lines
Vanilla tankers and freighters with livery WIP

Identity

Common Fire Solution shares observations to improve native missile guidance. Ordinary ships can develop a full solution alone. Command ships boost responsiveness, memory and simultaneous tracking.

Common Launch Protocol opens a six-second launch window after 0.9 seconds of preparation. Newly launched native missiles benefit from +25% damage, +50% speed and +50% turning throughout flight. In-flight missiles, aircraft do not receive that upload. NPC AIs have instructions to make best use of CLP.

Warships
Red Star - Missile Frigate
Mutual Aid - Escort Frigate
Commune - Missile Destroyer
Collective - Command Destroyer
Praxis - Torpedo Destroyer
Solidarity - Line Cruiser
Liberation - Torpedo Cruiser
Manifesto - Missile Cruiser
Emancipation - Escort Carrier
Initiative - Command Battlecruiser
Assembly - Command Carrier
Council - Missile Battleship

Flight sections
Vanguard - Four missile fighters
Unity - Three strike fighters combining kinetic and explosive missiles
Red Banner - Two torpedo bombers carrying heavy warheads

Precision arsenal
Spear-K - Fast kinetic missiles
Spear-H - Fast anti-armour missiles
Spear-KP - Two-stage kinetic pursuit missiles
Spear-KM - Kinetic MIRVs releasing three guided darts
Resolution - Heavy guided torpedoes
Declaration - Heavy long-range guided torpedoes
Declaration-K - Heavy long-range kinetic torpedoes

Logistics
Dram
Phaeton
Prometheus
Buffalo
Tarsus
Atlas

Campaign

Daybreak contains the planets Equality, Fellowship and Abundance. Located southeast of the core worlds. Starts hostile with multiple factions for ideological reasons. Nexerelin supports faction starts and fixed/random sectors.

Changelog

1.1.0 - Three new missiles, locked launcher conversion, auxiliary launchers nerf
1.2.0 - Missile effects, soft launch, built-in launcher restrictions, Improved CLP AI

Known issues, WIP

WIP more cooler missile trajectories like terminal RCS lateral thrust

Credits

AI was used for some of the loreful writing (planet introduction scenes, unique dialogue lines) and all of the ship 'art' and portraits - I just really wanted to make a unique missile doctrine-roster, largely to my own tastes and wishes, so that's where I spent my energy. I hope that's okay. Generated source images edited, color-graded for Starsector. Vanilla assets by Fractal Softworks.

Balance impressions are extremely welcome as this is my first roster, balancing is active WIP. Feedback is especially welcome on missile endurance, interception, carrier performance and how the ships feel in various mixed fleets.
